question: Where was the 2025 Open Championship (golf) played from July 17–20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Portrush, Northern Ireland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **153rd Open Championship** is scheduled to be held from **July 17 to July 20, 2025**.
 
• The designated venue for this prestigious event is the **Royal Portrush Golf Club**, located in **County Antrim, Northern Ireland**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Royal Portrush, Northern Ireland.***
 
• This marks the **third time** in the history of the tournament that it will be hosted at this venue. The previous occasions were in **1951** and **2019**.
 
• The selection of **Royal Portrush** follows the highly successful **2019** championship, which saw record-breaking attendance and was won by **Shane Lowry**.
 
• The **R&A** (The Royal and Ancient Golf Club of St Andrews) confirmed the return to **Northern Ireland** as part of its efforts to rotate the tournament among the UK's finest links courses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Open Championship:**
 
 
• Often referred to as **The British Open**, it is the **oldest** of the four major championships in professional golf, first played in **1860** at **Prestwick Golf Club**.
 
• It is the only major championship played outside the **United States** and is organized by the **R&A**.
 
• The winner is traditionally awarded the **Claret Jug** (officially the Golf Champion Trophy) and is crowned the **"Champion Golfer of the Year."**
 
 
 
• **Royal Portrush Golf Club:**
 
 
• Founded in **1888**, it features two links courses: the **Dunluce Links** (the championship course) and the **Valley Links**.
 
• The **Dunluce Links** is widely regarded as one of the most challenging and scenic courses in the world, famously redesigned by **Harry Colt** in **1929**.
 
 
 
• **The "Rota" System:**
 
 
• The Open is played on a rotation of ten coastal **links courses** across **Scotland**, **England**, and **Northern Ireland**.
 
• **St Andrews (Old Course)** is the most frequent host and typically hosts the tournament every **five years**.
 
• The **152nd Open** in **2024** was held at **Royal Troon** in **Scotland**, where **Xander Schauffele** emerged as the champion.
 
 
 
• **Future Venues:**
 
 
• Following the **2025** event at **Royal Portrush**, the **154th Open** is scheduled to take place at **Royal Birkdale** in **England** in **2026**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact:** Hosting the **Open Championship** provides a massive boost to the local economy; the **2019** event at **Portrush** generated over **£100 million** in economic benefit for **Northern Ireland**.
 
• **Field and Qualification:** The tournament features a field of **156 players**, consisting of the world's top-ranked professionals and golfers who qualify through various **Open Qualifying Series** events globally.
 
• **Course Modifications:** In preparation for **2025**, minor modifications and infrastructure improvements are often made to the **Dunluce Links** to accommodate modern hitting distances and large spectator galleries.
